stories.title: Peep and the Two-Feelings Present
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!
stories.moral: You can feel thankful and disappointed at the same time.
moralRhyme: Glad and sad can share a day,
Both our feelings get a say!

youtube.title: Peep and the Two-Feelings Present | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Peep smiled at her present while her eyes felt watery. Squeaks held the ribbon from a tiny green scarf. A gentle friendship story. You can feel thankful and disappointed at the same time. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Peep smiled at her present while her eyes felt watery.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Squeaks held the ribbon from a tiny green scarf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You made this scarf especially for me?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. I remembered how much you enjoy getting cozy.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep had hoped for the yellow scarf in the window.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The green one was soft and carefully folded.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Thank you for thinking about my chilly neck.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I chose the softest little piece of green cloth.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep tried smiling as brightly as she could.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The disappointed feeling stayed beneath her grateful one.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I should feel only happy about a present.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: You do not have to put on a giant smile.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep wrapped the green scarf around her little neck.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It felt wonderfully soft but still looked green.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Perhaps wearing it will change my other feeling.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Is it uncomfortable? We can loosen the knot.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Can Peep have two feelings at once?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Peep took the scarf off and held it carefully.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She did not want Squeaks to think she disliked her.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It is comfortable. I like how soft it feels.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then something else seems to be on your mind.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep pointed to the yellow flowers beyond the bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Squeaks sat close enough to hear her quiet voice.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I had imagined a scarf that color all week.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Ah. You were hoping for a yellow one.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep nodded while her grateful feeling grew warmer.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Her disappointed feeling had not vanished completely.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I feel glad you thought of me, and sad.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Those two feelings sound as though they arrived together.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Squeaks left the scarf folded in Peep's wings.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She did not hurry her friend into wearing it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I like having a friend I can tell things to.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And I like knowing what you really enjoy.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep stroked the soft green edge with one wing.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She noticed Squeaks's tiny careful stitches near the corner.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You spent time making this little part neat.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: That corner kept folding, so I stitched it twice.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Does Squeaks have to guess what Peep likes?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Peep thanked Squeaks for the cozy fabric and stitches.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then she laid the scarf beside her for a while.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I would like to wear it when I feel chilly.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It can wait here until you want it.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: A cool breeze passed between the garden flowers.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Peep picked up the scarf because her neck felt cold.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now I would like its cozy green hug.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Shall I help you make a loose little knot?
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep nodded and Squeaks helped settle the scarf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The yellow flowers bobbed beside their quiet bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I still like yellow best. This feels lovely too.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: You do not have to change your favorite color.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They watched the green leaves beside the yellow flowers.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Peep's two feelings settled comfortably alongside each other.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Thank you for listening to the whole answer.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Thank you for trusting me with both parts.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Peep tucked her chilly beak into the soft scarf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Squeaks smiled at its small, carefully stitched corner.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My neck has decided it likes this present.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your neck gives a very snuggly review.
lines.speaker: friend
